claims.summary: For Y evenly spread (rectangles R_j of area 1/N, Y_j in R_j within B(Y_j, 10/sqrt N)) and a square grid of side delta with 1/delta an integer, mu_Y = sum_j Unif(Q(Y_j)): (a) every G in W^(1,1) has |int G d mu_Y - N int G| <= 40 sqrt N (1 + 20/(delta sqrt N)) ||grad G||_1, at most 80 sqrt N ||grad G||_1 when delta >= 20/sqrt N; (b) for delta >= 20/sqrt N, every pair alpha in [1,infinity]^2 and every G with int sum_j psi*_alpha_j(|d_j G|) <= 2, ||grad G||_1 <= 2e, so the class discrepancy of the cell-smeared mu_X - mu_Y and the class supremum of the X-term sum_i E_{Q(X_i)} G - N int G differ by at most 160 e sqrt N; (c) if delta >= kappa sqrt(log N/N), with probability tending to one every cell holds at most c_kappa N delta^2 points of X (c_kappa = max(e^2, 2/kappa^2)) and then every G Lipschitz on each cell has |sum_i (E_{Q(X_i)} G - G(X_i))| <= sqrt 2 c_kappa N delta Lambda_delta(G), Lambda the cellwise Lipschitz sum; (d) at (4,4) on the reduction's grid, with probability tending to one, every class function whose larger partial is at least y >= e^16 where grad G != 0 has int G d(mu_X - mu_Y) <= C_L sqrt(N log N)(1 + Lambda_j(G)) for every j with 1 <= j <= j*(y).
claims.assessment: Working proof: (a) a flow moving each rectangle's density to its point's cell, with edge fluxes at most 40 delta sqrt N, summation by parts and the translation sweep; (b) psi*_alpha(t) >= t - (e-1); (c) Chernoff for the cell counts and the oscillation per cell; (d) lem:dominant-level-split with (b) and (c) and Lambda_delta <= 4 Lambda_j.
claims.rationale: The Y-term that the route's recent entries left aside costs O(sqrt N) for every class function at every pair, so conj:conjugate-class-discrepancy is the X-term bound for the cell averages up to O(sqrt N); and the record's Lebesgue bound for single-level functions carries to the goal's smeared form at the cost of the cellwise Lipschitz sum.
